DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP).

The clinical picture of a resting tremor, cognitive decline, and specifically "soft speech" (hypophonia) with reduced facial expressions (masked facies) is highly suggestive of PSP, a tauopathy often mimicking Parkinson's but with early fall risk and vertical gaze palsy (which we haven't yet confirmed).
